title: Tricopter model
current_gap: The tricopter is not covered by the quadrotor or hexarotor tickets; its separate configuration, drive/servo, model and test definitions are missing.

atoms.name: configuration_definition
atoms.required: Separate tricopter configuration: three rotors plus tail servo geometry, mass and inertia

atoms.name: drive_servo_mapping
atoms.required: Motor and tail-servo actuation mapping with units, signs and limits

atoms.name: model_test_definition
atoms.required: Owned dynamics model and its test definition with expected responses

atoms.name: non_coverage_rule
atoms.required: Rule enforced: quadrotor and hexarotor evidence never covers the tricopter

scope_rule: rotor count similarity never substitutes for a separate configuration; the tail servo is part of the actuation contract

preserved.quad_hex: Quad X and Hex evidence stays separate
